meta.title: 亲历星舰第六次试飞：看马斯克火箭如何冲向火星轨道
meta.title_en: Witnessing Starship Flight 6: Watching Musk's Rocket Head for Mars Orbit
meta.topic: 科技纪实 · 星舰第六次试飞

scenes.title_cn: 开场：登上特朗普空军一号
scenes.title_en: Opening: On Board Trump Force One
scenes.context: UP主说从没见过这样的景象，火箭上升时的噪音大到离谱。今天他们在特朗普空军一号上，准备观看星舰火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射。语域：英文纪实口播，现场感强烈。
sentences: 我从来没有见过这样的景象，火箭上升时的噪音大到离谱。
I've never seen something like that, and the noise of it when it was going up was insane.
the noise was insane（噪音大到离谱）；going up（上升时）
今天我们在特朗普空军一号上，准备观看星舰火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射。
Today we're on Trump Force One to watch the Starship rocket launch at Cape Canaveral.
Trump Force One（特朗普空军一号）；Cape Canaveral（卡纳维拉尔角）
我们离发射还有20分钟。
We're going off in 20 minutes.
go off（发射、出发）
paraphrase: 大到离谱 → was insane / absolutely deafening
insane · deafening
离发射20分钟 → going off in 20 minutes / T-minus 20 minutes
going off · T-minus
scenes.speak: I've never seen something like that, and the noise of it when it was going up was insane. Today we're on Trump Force One to watch the Starship rocket launch at Cape Canaveral. We're going off in 20 minutes.

scenes.title_cn: 认识星舰：背风侧与迎风侧
scenes.title_en: Getting to Know Starship: Leeward vs. Windward
scenes.context: 给观众看星舰的细节：正在看火箭的背风侧，另一面是迎风侧，上面布满了黑色陶瓷隔热瓦，是国际空间站上所用隔热瓦的更先进版本。语域：英文纪实解说，技术细节。
sentences: 我们正在看火箭的背风侧，另一面就是迎风侧。
We're looking at the leeward side of the rocket — the other side is the windward side.
the leeward side（背风侧）；the windward side（迎风侧）
迎风侧上面全都是黑色的隔热瓦，那些是陶瓷的，基本上就是隔热罩瓦片。
The windward side is all black tiles — those are ceramic, basically heat shield tiles.
heat shield tiles（隔热罩瓦片）；ceramic（陶瓷）
基本上是空间站上所用隔热瓦的更先进版本。
Basically a more advanced version of what was on the station.
a more advanced version（更先进的版本）
paraphrase: 背风侧/迎风侧 → leeward side / windward side
leeward · windward
隔热罩瓦片 → heat shield tiles / thermal protection tiles
heat shield · thermal tiles
scenes.speak: We're looking at the leeward side of the rocket — the other side is the windward side. The windward side is all black tiles — those are ceramic, basically heat shield tiles. Basically a more advanced version of what was on the station.

scenes.title_cn: 发射后的选择：为什么落入海里
scenes.title_en: After Launch: Why It Landed in the Sea
scenes.context: 发射后讲解：只有一切完美它才会回来着陆，但由于塔台有些担忧，它被命令在海上着陆。UP主问还能再用吗、能不能从海里取回——得到的回答是工厂里已经有更好的版本在生产。语域：英文对话，现场问答。
sentences: 它只有在一切完美的时候才会回来着陆，但我们对塔台有一些担忧，所以它被命令在海上着陆。
It only comes back to land if everything is super agreed, and we had some concerns about the tower, so it was commanded to land out to sea.
commanded to land（被命令着陆）；out to sea（在海上）
我们实际上已经有更好的版本正在那边的工厂里生产了。
We actually have better versions that are in production in those factories over there.
in production（生产中）
每次成功都有巨大的改进，下一版有大量的小改进。
There are big improvements with every success — the next one has a lot of small improvements.
improvements with every success（每次成功都有改进）
paraphrase: 被命令在海上着陆 → commanded to land out to sea / ordered to splash down
commanded to land · splash down
每次成功都有改进 → improvements with every success / iterating each flight
improvements · iterating
scenes.speak: It only comes back to land if everything is super agreed, and we had some concerns about the tower, so it was commanded to land out to sea. We actually have better versions that are in production in those factories over there. There are big improvements with every success — the next one has a lot of small improvements.

scenes.title_cn: 再入大气层：特效般的景象
scenes.title_en: Re-entry: A Sight Like Special Effects
scenes.context: 星舰正在绕地球飞行，将经过澳大利亚的乌苏海岸。UP主描述再入时像是特效——紫色、红色、白色各种颜色。这次将以更陡的角度进入，加热更严重，测试隔热罩的改进。语域：英文纪实解说，惊叹语气。
sentences: 再入大气层真的很狂野，看起来就像特效，因为每种颜色都有——紫色、红色、白色。
Re-entry is pretty wild — it looks like special effects, because it's every color: purple, red, white.
re-entry（再入）；special effects（特效）
这次我们以更陡的角度进入，所以加热会更严重，看看我们对隔热罩的改动是否更好。
This time we're entering at a steeper angle, so it's going to be higher heating — we'll see if the heat shield changes are better.
a steeper angle（更陡的角度）；higher heating（更高加热）
乌苏是澳大利亚一个美丽的海岸。
Oto is a beautiful coast in Australia.
a beautiful coast（美丽的海岸）
paraphrase: 像特效一样 → looks like special effects / like a sci-fi movie
special effects · sci-fi movie
更陡的角度 → a steeper angle / a sharper re-entry
steeper angle · sharper re-entry
scenes.speak: Re-entry is pretty wild — it looks like special effects, because it's every color: purple, red, white. This time we're entering at a steeper angle, so it's going to be higher heating — we'll see if the heat shield changes are better. Oto is a beautiful coast in Australia.

scenes.context: 观众问如果载人去火星，上升时的G力人体能否承受。回答是没问题，大概5个G；但回推点火是20个G，你不会想在那上面。这颗行星绕地速度约17000英里每小时，去火星可能35000英里每小时。语域：英文对话，科普问答。
sentences: 上升时的G力大概5个G，人体完全能承受，但回推点火是20个G，你不会想待在那上面。
Going up is fine, about five Gs — but the boost-back burn is doing 20 Gs, so you wouldn't want to be on that.
five Gs（5个G）；the boost-back burn（回推点火）
这颗星在轨道上大约17000英里每小时，但去火星你会快得多，也许35000英里每小时。
This vehicle does about 17,000 miles an hour, but going to Mars you'd go much faster — maybe 35,000 miles an hour.
miles an hour（英里每小时）
如果最大化载荷，到火星要6个月，但如果愿意牺牲载荷，可能压缩到3、4个月。
If you want to maximize payload, it takes six months; you can get it down to three or four if you sacrifice payload.
maximize payload（最大化载荷）；sacrifice payload（牺牲载荷）
paraphrase: 回推点火 → the boost-back burn / the flip maneuver
boost-back burn · flip maneuver
压缩到三四个月 → get it down to three or four months / cut it to 3–4 months
get it down to · cut to
scenes.speak: Going up is fine, about five Gs — but the boost-back burn is doing 20 Gs, so you wouldn't want to be on that. This vehicle does about 17,000 miles an hour, but going to Mars you'd go much faster — maybe 35,000 miles an hour. If you want to maximize payload, it takes six months; you can get it down to three or four if you sacrifice payload.

scenes.title_cn: 人类做过的最史诗级的事情
scenes.title_en: One of the Most Epic Things Humans Have Done
scenes.context: 现场对话：这比那个更难、风险更大。UP主说「这是我见过最史诗的人类壮举之一」，现场给了从未有过的冷颤——他只有在赢得锦标赛时才全身冷颤，而这次后背脊梁从上到下都在发冷。语域：英文对话，激动分享。
sentences: 这是人类做过的最史诗级的事情之一，风险比另一个大得多。
It's one of the most epic things humans have done — this has greater risks than the other one.
epic（史诗级）；greater risks（更大的风险）
我发誓我起了鸡皮疙瘩，我除了赢得锦标赛以外从来没起过鸡皮疙瘩。
I swear I got chills, and I never get chills besides winning tournaments.
get chills（起鸡皮疙瘩）；besides winning（除了赢）
这真的给我的后背脊梁从上到下带来了冷颤，这真的是我见过的最酷的事情之一。
This legitimately gave me chills down the back of my spine — honestly one of the coolest things ever.
chills down the spine（脊梁发冷）；one of the coolest things（最酷的事之一）
paraphrase: 史诗级 → epic / one for the history books
epic · history books
脊梁发冷 → chills down the spine / goosebumps down your back
chills down the spine · goosebumps
scenes.speak: It's one of the most epic things humans have done — this has greater risks than the other one. I swear I got chills, and I never get chills besides winning tournaments. This legitimately gave me chills down the back of my spine — honestly one of the coolest things ever.

scenes.title_cn: 幽默插曲：英雄联盟会毁掉太空计划
scenes.title_en: A Funny Aside: League Would Damage the Space Program
scenes.context: 轻松的插曲：问对方玩过堡垒之夜吗，原来玩过Quake等游戏。但问到玩不玩英雄联盟，回答是「如果我开始玩英雄联盟，那会毁掉太空计划」——十足的幽默。语域：英文对话，轻松闲聊。
sentences: 你玩过堡垒之夜吗？我以前喜欢Quake和一些其他第一人称射击游戏。
Did you ever play Fortnite? I used to like Quake and a bunch of other first-person shooters.
first-person shooters（第一人称射击游戏）
如果我开始玩英雄联盟，那会毁掉太空计划。
If I start playing League, it will damage the space program.
damage the space program（毁掉太空计划）
这是一个非常好的回答。
That's great.
that's great（很好）
paraphrase: 毁掉太空计划 → damage the space program / derail the mission
damage the program · derail the mission
轻松的插曲 → a funny aside / a light-hearted moment
funny aside · light-hearted
scenes.speak: Did you ever play Fortnite? I used to like Quake and a bunch of other first-person shooters. If I start playing League, it will damage the space program. That's great.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：改变整个人生视角
scenes.title_en: Ending: It Changed My Entire Perspective
scenes.context: 结尾：这真的改变了我的整个人生视角。感谢今天的嘉宾，以一件T恤作为礼物——「这是我们的T恤，也是我们的人生」。最后告别，约定下回再见。语域：英文对话，真挚收尾。
sentences: 我认为这改变了我的整个人生视角。
I think that changed my entire perspective.
change my entire perspective（改变整个人生视角）
这是我们的T恤，这是我们的命运。
It's our T-shirt, it's our life.
our T-shirt, our life（我们的T恤，我们的人生）
这车开起来真快，太棒了，谢谢你，拜拜。
It drives pretty quick, so it's really great — thank you very much, bye bye.
drives pretty quick（开起来很快）；bye bye（拜拜）
paraphrase: 改变人生视角 → changed my entire perspective / reframed how I see things
entire perspective · reframed
最酷的经历 → one of the coolest experiences ever / a once-in-a-lifetime
coolest experiences · once-in-a-lifetime
scenes.speak: I think that changed my entire perspective. It's our T-shirt, it's our life. It drives pretty quick, so it's really great — thank you very much, bye bye.

practice: The noise of it going up was insane — I've never seen anything like it.
It was commanded to land out to sea because of concerns about the tower.
Re-entry looks like special effects — every color: purple, red, white.
It gave me chills down the back of my spine — truly one of the coolest things ever.
pitfalls: The rocket's noise is very big.
The noise of it going up was insane.
very big 口语无力；用 insane / deafening / overwhelming 形容现场震撼。
It can get back from the sea?
Can they recover it from the sea?
can't get back 是被动回收，英文用 recover（回收）更准确。
Going to Mars takes 6 months at max payload.
If you want to maximize payload, it takes six months.
at max payload 中式；用 to maximize payload（要最大化载荷）表达条件。
英文表示「起鸡皮疙瘩」用 get chills 或 get goosebumps，不是 goose pimples（中式翻译）。
shifts: 用 insane（离谱）、epic（史诗级）、chills down my spine（脊梁发冷）
用 greater risks（更大风险）、commanded to land out to sea（被迫海上着陆）
说改变了看法只会 changed me
用 changed my entire perspective（改变整个人生视角）、reframed how I see things（重塑认知）
footer_notes: 本视频为英文原声纪实对话，中文为翻译。ASR 专有名词已校正：Trump Force one→特朗普空军一号、Graham/格兰→Graham、Orex Sondering→Oto（乌苏海岸）、Lipmotor→零跑、Nutella→能多益巧克力酱、JKR→某歌手、pumpkin spice→南瓜香料、T03→零跑T03、600nm→600nm、10,000元→人民币、Eletra→Eletre、CLA→CLA、L9→理想L9、Mega→MEGA、Li Auto→理想、F1→F1等。
